# hamburg.com

> > Official English guide to Hamburg, Germany – covering tourism, business location factors, urban development, and public services for visitors and residents.

hamburg.com serves as the comprehensive portal for Hamburg, the Free and Hanseatic City, featuring iconic landmarks like the Elbphilharmonie and HafenCity, major events including Hamburg Port Anniversary and Hamburg DOM, and information about the Port of Hamburg. The site highlights Hamburg's innovation in mobility (HEAT autonomous transport, electric vehicles), cultural attractions, musicals, and practical services for both tourists and residents.

## Key Topics

- Hamburg
- HafenCity urban development
- Elbphilharmonie concert hall
- Port of Hamburg
- Hamburg Port Anniversary
- Hamburg DOM festival
- River Elbe
- Elbtower skyscraper
- HEAT autonomous transportation
- Hamburg musicals
- Electric vehicles and mobility innovation
- Cultural attractions and city tourism
- Hamburg business location
- Public transport (Hamburger Hochbahn AG)
- Visitor information and discount cards

## Essential Hamburg Guide

- [hamburg.com – Your Guide to Exploring, Living & Working in Hamburg](https://www.hamburg.com/?ba=other): Official English homepage for Hamburg, Germany - visitor & resident guide
- [Visitors – The Best Things to Do in Hamburg](https://www.hamburg.com/visitors/): Main visitor guide covering attractions, musicals, events & getting around

## Business & Location

- [Location Factors](https://www.hamburg.com/business/location-factors): Hamburg business location overview: port, skilled workers & industries
- [Port of Hamburg](https://www.hamburg.com/business/port-of-hamburg): Port of Hamburg guide: logistics, HHLA operations & maritime tourism
- [Made in Hamburg](https://www.hamburg.com/business/made-in-hamburg): Hamburg-made products & brands: Nivea, Hansaplast, Montblanc & media

## Urban Development & Innovation

- [HafenCity Hamburg](https://www.hamburg.com/business/port-of-hamburg/hafencity-hamburg-879980): HafenCity urban development project near Elbphilharmonie & River Elbe
- [Mobility Strategies and Innovation in Hamburg](https://www.hamburg.com/business/mobility): Urban mobility innovation: electric vehicles, autonomous driving & HEAT
- [HEAT: Hamburg Electric Autonomous Transportation in HafenCity](https://www.hamburg.com/heat-17268): HEAT autonomous electric shuttle bus research project in HafenCity
- [Elbtower Hamburg](https://www.hamburg.com/business/port-of-hamburg/elbtower-17174): Elbtower: Hamburg's tallest skyscraper development in HafenCity by 2026

## Resident Services

- [apply for registration certificate](https://www.hamburg.com/publicservice/info/111001492/n0): Apply for resident registration certificate at Hamburg registration office
- [Housing benefit calculator for Hamburg - Information](https://www.hamburg.com/publicservice/info/111003388): Calculate housing benefit & rent subsidy eligibility for Hamburg residents
- [Voluntary Ecological Year General Information - Authority for the Environment, Climate, Energy and Agriculture](https://www.hamburg.com/publicservice/info/111024545): Voluntary Ecological Year program for environmental & climate volunteering
- [Waste and Disposal - Waste Management Plans - Environment, Climate, Energy and Agriculture Authority](https://www.hamburg.com/publicservice/info/111031516): Hamburg waste management plans & disposal information from city authority
- [Construction worker protection telephone - Information](https://www.hamburg.com/publicservice/info/111033831): Construction site safety hotline: worker protection & accident reporting
- [Recalculate tax interest](https://www.hamburg.com/publicservice/info/111006763/n0): Tax interest recalculation following Federal Constitutional Court ruling
